info.description: # napari-apply-transforms [![License BSD-3](https://img.shields.io/pypi/l/napari-apply-transforms.svg?color=green)](https://github.com/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms/raw/main/LICENSE) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/napari-apply-transforms.svg?color=green)](https://pypi.org/project/napari-apply-transforms) [![Python Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/napari-apply-transforms.svg?color=green)](https://python.org) [![tests](https://github.com/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms/workflows/tests/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms/actions) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms) [![napari hub](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://api.napari-hub.org/shields/napari-apply-transforms)](https://napari-hub.org/plugins/napari-apply-transforms) [![npe2](https://img.shields.io/badge/plugin-npe2-blue?link=https://napari.org/stable/plugins/index.html)](https://napari.org/stable/plugins/index.html) [![Copier](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/copier-org/copier/master/img/badge/badge-grayscale-inverted-border-purple.json)](https://github.com/copier-org/copier) Apply scale → shear → rotate → translate → affine (in this order) to layers. The goal was to allow user to save their csv of points after applying transforms to the points layer. Steps to reproduce: - Open napari - Create a points layer and populate it - Change any of its transformed (for example scale using plugin > napari metadata > layer metadata) - Open the apply transform widgets (Plugin > Apply Points Transforms) - Choose which transforms you want to apply - All the selected transforms will be applied to the coordinates of the points. The unselected transforms will be copied to the layer attributes. All points should have the same position than the source layer. - You can now save or apply downstream analysis with applied transforms! > For now only points layers are supported, but open to issues/PRs to add support for other layers. ---------------------------------- This [napari] plugin was generated with [copier] using the [napari-plugin-template] (None). ## Installation You can install `napari-apply-transforms` via [pip]: ```bash pip install napari-apply-transforms ``` If napari is not already installed, you can install `napari-apply-transforms` with napari and Qt via: ```bash pip install "napari-apply-transforms[all]" ``` To install latest development version: ```bash pip install git+https://github.com/ClementCaporal/napari-apply-transforms.git ``` ## Contributing Contributions are very welcome. Tests can be run with [tox], please ensure the coverage at least stays the same before you submit a pull request. ## License Distributed under the terms of the [BSD-3] license, "napari-apply-transforms" is free and open source software ## Issues If you encounter any problems, please [file an issue] along with a detailed description.
